description: Nombrio checks brand names against live data while you brainstorm: a US trademark verdict with a risk band, an EU trademark screen, domain availability with real prices, social handles, developer namespaces, and the App Store. Ask about one name or compare several — results come back ranked, with a link to the full interactive result on nombrio.com. Free, anonymous, no sign-up. Trademark results are informational and not legal advice.
